data.gender_notes: Thurstan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘Þorstan’ meaning ‘Thor’s stone’ or ‘Thor’s steadfast man’. Thor was the Norse god of thunder, strength, and protection. Thurstan was a popular name among Anglo-Saxons, Normans, and early English Christians. The name Thurstan carries the meaning “Strong man of Thor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Thurstan usually hope their child will grow to embody strong man of thor and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Thurstan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
